name: Stillwater Pond
summary: Just west of Brill, Stillwater Pond lies gray and lifeless, a lost refuge for Lordaeron's children.

sections.title: A Ruined Respite
sections.body: Families from nearby hamlets once picnicked on Stillwater Pond's grassy banks. Before the Third War and the Plague of Undeath, its shallows let children too young to brave Brightwater Lake learn to swim. Now the water is gray and lifeless. The living have vanished, leaving skeletal fish below and wandering undead in the woods around it.

sections.title: Prowlers in the Mist
sections.body: Stillwater Pond is quieter than Tirisfal's besieged roads and contested farms, yet danger lingers along its shore. Blighted beasts drink from the murky water, including Bayne, a ferocious darkhound that stalks the banks. Travelers crossing the western meadows toward Brill must watch for predatory beasts and aimless zombies by the water's edge.

faq.q: What was Stillwater Pond like before the Plague?
aliases: what was stillwater pond used for
faq.answer: Before the Plague, families from nearby hamlets came to Stillwater Pond for picnics in human Lordaeron. Its shallows were calmer than Brightwater Lake, so parents brought young children there to swim.

faq.q: Is there anything living in the water now?
faq.answer: No normal aquatic life survived Tirisfal's blighting. Only animated skeletal fish swim beneath the gray surface, left by the Scourge's corruption.

faq.q: What dangerous creatures wander near the pond?
faq.answer: Mindless undead wander the glades, and Bayne is the shore's most notorious threat. The unusually powerful, aggressive darkhound feeds on unwary travelers.
Stillwater Pond lies in central Tirisfal Glades, directly west of Brill and southwest of Brightwater Lake.

angles.text: As a Forsaken who remembers life in Lordaeron, you may recall childhood picnics and swims along Stillwater Pond's once-clear banks.
As a hunter, you face blighted wildlife around the pond, including feral darkhounds like Bayne. The shore is hazardous hunting ground for scouts patrolling Brill's outskirts.
